ambiguity.wind_direction_rule: unit d in (v_x, v_z) maximizing (h_wall/|h_wall| + h_floor/|h_floor|)^T (I - A_K)^{-1} d
ambiguity.reference_radius: r = delta * rho_w (fixed, independent of controller design radius)

sim.fig1_rule: student_t, largest in-ball delta in grid (1.0), first 100 trajectories by index

stats.coverage: per scenario, simultaneous over (controller, row, time); unstudentized max centered deviation

baselines.COV: IF-SMPC with Sigma_w replaced by (1 + rho_w/sqrt(tr Sigma_w))^2 Sigma_w, no mean term (homothetic covariance inflation)
baselines.WAS: Gaussian-centered type-1 Wasserstein IF baseline: margin = phi(Phi^-1(1-eps))/eps sqrt(h'Sigma_e h) + rho_e ||h||/eps with rho_e from rho_W and the same p-step bound; rho_W closed form so the steady-state wall margin equals DR-MPC's
baselines.ORC: true-moment tightening oracle per delta: m(t) = h'mu_e(t) + kappa sqrt(h'Sigma_e(t)h), tightening uses the running max from t=0; sets at infinity use max(prefix max over t<orc_T0, bounded tail); oracle information only in the tightening, cost unchanged
baselines.scenario_controllers: DR, IF, COV, WAS, ORC(delta of the scenario)
